caption: the flock returns with card-boosted slingshots - the sequel the store still carries.
about: Angry birds 2 rebuilt the slingshot formula: multi-stage levels, a spell-card boost system and a flock you pick per shot instead of a fixed order. The destructibility physics stayed the soul of the game, and the windows store build runs the same saga as every other platform.
The store listing is free with the usual boost monetization, and store.rg-adguard mirrors the appx package for offline installs.

req.note: below target - casual 2d physics; the bar is a formality.

links.official_note: free on the microsoft store - the windows appx route.
